Hi Lisa — thanks for the note and the attachment. I pulled the payment record on our side and see the $124,350 ACH hit our bank with the reference BBX-06012026-842. We posted it this morning to a holding receipt and then performed an automated allocation run which applied $105,600 to the invoices you listed and left $18,750 as unapplied pending manual review.

Quick context on our posting process: 
- Automated allocation matches by invoice number and exact amount.
- When remittance contains aggregated lines or descriptions that don't match exact invoice numbers, the system places the remainder in "unapplied receipts" until accounting confirms allocation.

Two asks so we can resolve this today:
1) Can you send the remittance CSV (line-level) showing per-invoice amounts — that will allow us to reconcile the remaining $18,750 immediately.
2) If possible, confirm whether the $3,250 prior credit was applied to RBW-20260509 or held separately — our allocation logic treats credits differently depending on the reference.
